# SQL indexing
- Goal: be ready for the SQL indexing questions that may come up in a Rust-focused technical interview
- Deadline: none
- Kind: mixed
- Standard: answers hold under follow-up at the level expected of a mid-level Rust engineer in a technical interview
- Working language: English
- Exam conditions: closed-book; text

## Syllabus
1. B-tree index structure and lookup cost
2. Composite indexes and column order
3. Covering indexes and index-only access
4. Selectivity, statistics, and when the planner skips an index
5. Clustered vs. secondary indexes
6. Write cost and maintenance of indexes
7. Reading query plans
8. Non-B-tree and special indexes (hash, partial, expression)

## Out of scope
- None stated by the learner. Questions are engine-agnostic: no engine-specific syntax or internals are required.

## Sources
- None listed.
